acceptance_checks.criterion: finite public-source Phase 5A record; external regression/privacy suite required
acceptance_checks.description: strict finite record, public-source-only artifacts, and Phase 5A scope

background.description: Phenomenological bottom-up DGR EMD model restricted to the neutral black-hole branch; the Maxwell sector is linear response only.

boundary_conditions.interpretation: Both physical endpoints are Chebyshev nodes.
boundary_conditions.role: normalized boundary and regular simple horizon

boundary_conditions.interpretation: The physical horizon value is phi_0 = x_H P(1).
The leading scalar backreaction power is explicit.

boundary_conditions.expression: retain the undivided scalar equation at u = 1
boundary_conditions.interpretation: No fitted horizon boundary value is introduced.

configuration.ensemble: zero chemical potential; neutral background with linear Maxwell response
configuration.units: L = 1 and kappa_5^2 = 1 before source rescalings

contract_review.phase_5b_amendment: Figure 5 is mandatory; Figure 4 is diagnostic only and not a required reproduction target.

equations.expression: h phi'' + (3 A' h + h') phi' - exp(2A) V_phi = 0

equations.kind: linear response on a neutral background

numerical_method.nonlinear_solver: hybr then accepted bounded TRF polish when triggered
numerical_method.physical_targeting: deterministic bracketed x_H to phi_H inversion
numerical_method.quadrature: Gauss--Legendre on the analytic spectral representation

observables.extraction: absolute exact-horizon blackening derivative divided by 4 pi
observables.normalization: lambda_T = 252 MeV for the Figure 3 plot

observables.extraction: 2 pi exp(3 A_H)/T^3 with the source scale dictionary
1/[2 I T^2], I = integral dz exp(-A)/f_EMD
observables.normalization: lambda_mu = 972 MeV and the source scale dictionary

scope: AI-assisted, owner-approved numerical reproduction of the two DGR black-hole curves in source Figure 3 at zero chemical potential. Passing verifies the selected public source-model calculation; it does not validate QCD or lattice data and does not calculate Figure 5, a critical point, finite-density phase structure, or critical exponents.

solvers.description: Deterministic continuation and bracketing target the twenty physical source horizon values.
Reconstructs T, s, the Maxwell integral, and chi_2/T^2.
solvers.method: DOP853 with analytic horizon master-field series
